headline.zh: 自烘豆+19世纪古董磨豆机

traits.zh: 店内陈列19世纪手摇磨豆机等古董咖啡器具
traits.en: Displays antique coffee tools, including a 19th-century hand grinder

traits.zh: 每杯咖啡附手写风味卡，含产地、处理法和品鉴笔记
traits.en: Each coffee comes with a handwritten tasting card: origin, process, notes

traits.zh: 四平路首店位于N-ICE2035未来生活原型街居民区弄堂内
traits.en: First location is in a residential alley as part of N-ICE2035 community project

traits.zh: 营业时间09:00–18:00，晚间时段转变为酒吧模式
traits.en: Open 9:00–18:00; transforms into a bar in the evening

traits.zh: 主理人陈昱亨网络名“路易欠蹬”，运营咖啡专业测评账号
traits.en: Founder Chen Yuheng runs the coffee review account 'Louis Qian Deng'
